en: A black-and-white aerial photograph showing a manor complex consisting of a central two‑storey main building with a dark pitched roof and small clock/bell turret, flanked by two long one‑storey side buildings. The buildings are arranged around a curved driveway and surrounded by trees and gardens. Printed captions in Swedish appear at the bottom, including the name of the estate and the photo studio in Stockholm.
